name: Third-year student: assignment, exam prep around Shabbat, morning workouts
notes: today is fixed via DAILY_TASKS_TODAY so both runs see identical calendar data.
2026-10-28 is a Wednesday: 'tomorrow' = Thu 10-29, Friday = 10-30, Shabbat = 10-31.
Hebcal, Jerusalem: candle lighting Fri 2026-10-30 16:11, havdalah Sat 2026-10-31 17:28.
Each session runs on a NEW agent instance; session 2 knows only what is on disk.
Checks run after the turn named in 'after' (default: end of scenario). Most check saved files.

turns.goal: tool use: add two study tasks
turns.prompt: Add two study tasks for tomorrow: submit Assignment 3 for the AI Agents course at 10:00, two hours, high priority. And a review for the Statistics exam at 14:00, 90 minutes.

turns.goal: save to memory: two lasting preferences
turns.prompt: Two things to remember long-term: workouts only in the morning, before 9:00. And no studying after 22:00.

turns.goal: external tool: Hebcal decides what fits around Shabbat
turns.prompt: Schedule 3 hours of review for the Algorithms exam on Friday, and another 3 hours on Saturday.

turns.goal: fixed confirmation: the agent books what it proposed in s1-3
tool use: find and complete a task that is not in today's context
turns.prompt: I already finished tomorrow's Statistics review, you can mark it as done.

turns.goal: retrieve from memory in a new session
turns.prompt: What's planned for me tomorrow, and what preferences did I save about workouts and studying?

turns.goal: request that contradicts a saved preference (morning workouts)
turns.prompt: Schedule a 30-minute home workout for me tomorrow at 20:00.

turns.goal: user resolves the conflict as a one-time exception
turns.prompt: It's a one-time thing, I have exams this week. Schedule it at 20:00 anyway, without changing the preference.

checks.description: Assignment saved for Thu 10:00, study, high priority, 120 min
Both preferences saved to preferences.json with the right categories
get_jewish_calendar was called when planning Friday/Saturday
After s1-3 (before the confirmation) no Algorithms task exists outside Friday: the Saturday replacement was not booked without asking
Friday has study time scheduled, and every Friday task ends by candle lighting (16:11)
No task overlaps Shabbat (Fri 16:11 to Sat 17:28); a Saturday task without a time also fails
No two tasks share date, start time and category (the 'yes' turn must not re-book)
The s1-3 answer tells the user why the Saturday part was not booked as asked
Session 2 answer mentions the morning rule and the 10:00 assignment
After the 20:00 request, no evening workout was added yet (agent asked first)
After the user confirmed a one-time exception, the Thu 20:00 workout exists
The morning-workout preference is unchanged after the exception
